summary: A web-component Lottie player whose GitHub repository is archived. It is MIT and has an npm attestation, but it has not shipped since November 2024, pulls lit, pako, lottie-web and two polyfills, and is not a React-first integration. Do not adopt it for this requirement.
reasoning: The GitHub repository is archived; the last release is 2.0.12 on 2024-11-04.
It is a custom element, not a React component; using it from React means a web-component bridge.
It depends on lottie-web ^5.12.2, so it inherits the stale JSON renderer and eval usage.
It has five runtime dependencies including lit, pako, lottie-web, @types/pako and resize-observer-polyfill.
The package itself is MIT, the dependency tree is permissive (pako is MIT AND Zlib), it has no install scripts and it has an npm attestation.
Maintenance and fit fail the requirement.
caveats: Archived and no release in more than 12 months.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: 2.0.12 published 2024-11-04; repository archived; no release in more than 12 months.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT. The tree is permissive: lit and resize-observer-polyfill are BSD-3-Clause/MIT, pako is MIT AND Zlib, lottie-web is MIT.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 5 runtime dependencies; 39 MB installed; 6.8 MB unpacked.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script.

evidence.label: React integration
evidence.detail: Web component, not a React component. It requires a custom-element bridge.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: OSV returned no advisories at the reviewed version.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: An npm attestation is present for 2.0.12, although the publisher is a personal npm account rather than an OIDC trusted publisher.
